title: authoring chamber v1 index — DELIBERATELY-FAILING fixture
$comment: WRONGLY carries a predicate-signing `signing_mode` field on an authoring catalog. Authoring conformance is a DETERMINISTIC LINT, never a signed attestation (DR-049 D-SAK-1 CISO binding). The runtime chamber MAY carry signing_mode; the authoring chamber MAY NOT. The gate MUST catch this.
